defs.def: in every way possible; completely 全部地；完整地；完全地

ex.s: Climate change is also quickening the loss of biodiversity, threatening to erase certain smells entirely.
ex.t: 当植物消失时，它们的气味变得更加难以产生。

ex.s: Print texts cannot be entirely replaced in education.
ex.t: 纸质文本在教育中无法被完全取代。

ex.s: So I was actually reading it again, but what I was rereading seemed entirely new.
ex.t: 所以我其实是在重读它，但我重读的内容似乎完全是全新的。

ex.s: Perhaps your household won’t entirely make the switch, but you may have some control over your own personal spaces to make the changes you desire.
ex.t: 也许你的家庭不会完全转变，但你可能对自己的个人空间有一些控制权来做你想做的改变。

ex.s: Asking about “the point” of ALife might be, well, missing the point entirely, he says.
ex.t: 询问ALife的"意义"可能——嗯——完全偏离了重点，他说。

ex.s: The place wasn’t entirely authentic, though.
ex.t: 不过，这个地方并非完全正宗。

ex.s: This camp takes creative license to an entirely new level.
ex.t: 这个夏令营把创作自由发挥到了一个全新的高度。

ex.s: We did not speak the local language, did not know the customs, and more often than not, did not entirely recognize the food.
ex.t: 我们不会说当地语言，不了解当地习俗，而且往往认不出食物。

ex.s: This new start gave me an opportunity to redefine myself and discover an entirely new version of "cool".
ex.t: 这个新的开始让我有机会重新定义自己，并发现一个全新的“酷”的版本。

ex.s: For many students, Wilson's help is not only appreciated, it's also entirely   26   for them to be able to complete their college education.
ex.t: 对许多学生来说，威尔逊的帮助不仅受感激，而且对他们的大学教育完成也是完全____26____的。

ex.s: It is absolutely astonishing to see a superhighway world map made entirely of wires and cables.
ex.t: 看到完全由电线和电缆制成的高速公路世界地图，绝对令人惊讶。

ex.s: A human being should be entirely beautiful: the face, the clothes, the mind, the thoughts.
ex.t: 一个人应该从头到脚都是美的：面容、衣着、心灵、思想。

ex.s: The dictionary, which contained some 15 million characters, was the first English dictionary to be independently compiled by an entirely Chinese team of lexicographers, of whom Lu remained chief editor for ten years.
ex.t: 这本包含约1500万个字符的词典是第一本由完全由中国词典编纂者团队独立编纂的英语词典，其中卢先生担任主编长达十年。

ex.s: After Sherlock Holmes made him a household name, Doyle gave up medicine and devoted himself entirely to writing.
ex.t: 在夏洛克·福尔摩斯让他家喻户晓之后，道尔放弃了医学，全身心投入写作。

ex.s: With the eyes of students across the nation upon her, she might have inspired an entirely new generation of astronauts and space scientists.
ex.t: 在全国学生的注视下，她或许激励了整整新一代的宇航员和太空科学家。
